policy: Public whole/mixed/fraction operands, conversions, reciprocal components, products and reduction are learner-entered in symbolic frames. No numeric operand prefill or main-answer transfer.
fixedConcept: A whole number has an equivalent fraction with denominator1; the instructional rule is stated, but the input remains blank.
checks: Independent printed mixed-number conversion and exact arithmetic across all operand positions.
Original unreduced operands and question identity are preserved; answer/expression metadata mutation does not alter helper values.
Blank/incorrect inputs are rejected, completed learner-entered fractions match the public calculation, old drafts reset and current partial drafts restore.
Existing four FractionProducts unit tests retain operand variants, distinct choice values, all four answer positions and curriculum placements.
KO/EN/PT titles, instructions and symbolic frames.
initialFailure: The initial two-fraction-only helper missed fracDivInt whose public prompt is (fraction) / whole number. It is now routed through the whole/mixed operand helper with reader-only normalization; original question and answer metadata are unchanged.
scope: Current positive whole numbers and positive proper fraction parts in the existing public operand reader. Signed/zero mixed-number families are not introduced by this change.
limitations: Other fraction concept helpers and the full global app remain incomplete.
UI, native learner inputs, screenshots and APK artifacts remain private.
